KXMLBALLSTAR.note: No listing, title only. All-Star roster selection is decided by fan ballot, player ballot and commissioner picks on first-half performance and popularity: a voting process like the awards archetype, not exhibition-game play. Low confidence is kept.

KXMLBASGMVP.note: The ASG MVP outcome is generated by events in one exhibition game: which league wins, the limited plate appearances and innings each All-Star gets, and who homers. Those are the inputs of unreg:all_star_week_events, which already holds ASG winner/hits/HR/K series. A season-long award ballot does not generate it.

KXMLBBGAME.note: The rules text is a Mobile Legends: Bang Bang MPL Indonesia esports match carried under a KXMLB prefix. It has no link to baseball performance or MLB decisions, so OUT_OF_SCOPE:esports with a verbatim quote is correct.

KXMLBDRAFTPICK.note: No listing. A team's draft selection is a front-office decision driven by boards, signability and bonus pools, and it surfaces through insider reports. The transactions mechanism generates that, and awards does not. A single series does not justify a new archetype. It may instead be a draft-lottery market, so low confidence is kept.

KXMLBOPENINGDAY.note: The rules settle on whether the 2027 season's first game happens before May 31, 2027. That depends on MLB-MLBPA collective bargaining after the CBA expires on Dec 1 2026: lockout timing, negotiation deadlines and game cancellations. No trade, signing or manager change generates it, so it gets a new labour/schedule archetype.

KXMLBPLAYOFFHOST.note: Playoff games hosted is generated by seeding (home-field pattern), how far the club advances and how long each series runs: a best-of-N path. The playoff_series_markets target names it explicitly. A pure advancement future would miss the series-length component.

KXMLBPLAYOFFHRS.note: League-wide postseason home-run count at a threshold. It equals the number of playoff games played (series lengths) times the per-game HR rate. The family is only two series (with walk-offs), and counting specials covers team/league counts, so no new archetype. It is not a single-game hitter prop.

KXMLBSEASONGAMES.note: Settles on more than 600 of the 2,430 2027 regular-season games being played. It fails only if a work stoppage wipes out most of the season, so the outcome is a collective-bargaining/lockout tail event, not a transaction. Moved together with Opening Day to the new labour archetype.

KXMLBSEASONHR.note: Rules: a player reaches 50+ HR across the regular season. The season_leaders_and_awards target explicitly includes a player's season total threshold, and its process (playing time × rate over the remaining schedule) generates this. A single-game HR ladder does not.

KXMLBSERIES.note: Championship Series winner per rules. It is generated by game-by-game win probabilities over a best-of-7 with a home-field pattern and rotation resets. Five series share this mechanism, so the new playoff_series_markets archetype is justified over game_moneyline or season_futures.

KXMLBSERIESGAMES.note: Rules: 'more than 6.5 games' in the Championship Series, i.e. the series goes seven. Series length is a best-of-N path quantity, not a runs total, so it belongs in playoff_series_markets.

KXMLBSERIESGAMETOTAL.note: No listing. The title describes the same series-length object as KXMLBSERIESGAMES, so the archetype is right and medium is the cap without rules text. The first-pass reason does not say that it rests only on the title.

KXMLBSERIESSPREAD.note: Rules: 'wins by more than 3.5 games', which only a 4-0 sweep satisfies in a best-of-7. That is a function of the series path, so playoff_series_markets is right and game_moneyline is wrong.

KXMLBSTARTER.note: No listing. A starting-pitcher market (which pitcher starts, or whether a named pitcher starts) is a participation outcome driven by rotation slot, rest and probable announcements. player_participation is the right archetype even if its record has to add rotation inputs. Low confidence is kept.

KXMLBSTATCOUNT.note: Rules: a joint season threshold of at least 50 HR AND at least 40 SB in regular-season games. It is a player season-total threshold covered by season_leaders_and_awards. Its record must treat the HR/SB correlation through playing time as a joint distribution.

KXMLBSTGAME.note: No listing. A spring-training game winner is a game result, so game_moneyline. Split squads, early pitcher hooks and the possibility of ties change the inputs, and the tie settlement is unverified. Low confidence is kept.

KXMLBWALKOFFS.note: Rules count all postseason walk-offs (the secondary text defines a walk-off as any game-ending home-team winning run in the 9th or extras), not only walk-off HRs. It is a league-wide event count over playoff games, which fits counting specials and not hitter_home_runs.

KXMLBWSTREAK.note: Rules: the team with the longest regular-season winning streak, with split payout on ties. It is an extreme-value function of team strength and schedule over 162 games, which the season_futures team-season mechanism generates. It is not an inning market.

KXMLBASGMVP.reason: No market listed; the All-Star Game MVP is almost always on the winning league, and among players who get enough plate appearances or innings in the exhibition, so the outcome is generated by the same exhibition-game process (selected rosters, rotating substitutions, limited PAs) as the All-Star Game winner/hits/HR series, not by a season-long award ballot.

KXMLBOPENINGDAY.quote: If the first game in the 2027 MLB regular season has taken place prior to May 31, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXMLBOPENINGDAY.reason: Whether the 2027 season starts before May 31 is determined by MLB-MLBPA bargaining after the CBA expiry on Dec 1 2026: whether owners lock out, how long negotiations run and which games are cancelled. It is a league-union process, not a team transaction, so it belongs in a labour/schedule archetype.

KXMLBSEASONGAMES.quote: If the number of MLB regular season games played is above 600 games in the 2027 MLB regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXMLBSEASONGAMES.reason: The 2027 schedule has 2,430 games, so this settles NO only if a work stoppage cancels roughly three quarters of the season. The outcome is set by the length of any lockout or strike and the games MLB cancels or reschedules, which is the same bargaining process as the Opening Day market.

labour_stoppage_and_season_schedule.label: Labour stoppage and league season-schedule markets
contract_types: Regular-season games played above a threshold
labour_stoppage_and_season_schedule.target: Whether the MLB regular season starts before a date or plays more than N games, as determined by collective bargaining, any lockout or strike, and the games the league cancels.
labour_stoppage_and_season_schedule.why_distinct: The outcome is produced by owner-union collective bargaining (CBA expiry, lockout decision, negotiation deadlines, cancellation and make-up policy). The transactions archetype models team personnel moves, and no other archetype models a league-wide stoppage.
